paragraphs: Rabbi Yosi ha-Kohen. (An Amora in Eretz Israel).
He is mentioned in Rosh Hashanah 15b: Rabbi Abba ha-Kohen said to Rabbi Yosi ha-Kohen, 'Why did Rabbi Yohanan fall silent before Resh Lakish?' etc.
In Taanit 13, Rabbi Abba the Priest relates that Rabbi Yose, son of Rabbi Chanina, lost his sons. Hyman infers that Yose the Priest belonged to the third generation of Amoraim in the Land of Israel.

notes.text: Rosh Hashanah טו: is rendered 15b by the source’s punctuation convention. Taanit יג followed by a comma supplies no side, so the English retains folio 13. The third-generation inference is Hyman’s; its pronoun can be read as Yose the Priest, although Abba the Priest is the speaker in both cited passages.
